tex_content.html:
Corollary
1. ch12:12.14If a smooth manifold $M$ admits a complete Riemannian metric of nonpositive sectional curvature, then $M$ is aspherical.
Proof

\sketch Cartan–Hadamard identifies the universal cover with $\mathbb R^n$, which is contractible. Covering maps induce isomorphisms on $\pi _k$ for $k>1$, so all higher homotopy groups of $M$ vanish.

□
